report:
Simplified audit_formatter.py by removing the unnecessary abstraction layers (AbstractAuditFormatter, BaseAuditFormatter, StandardAuditFormatter, AuditFormatterFactory, AuditFormatterManager) and replaced them with a direct format_audit_event function. Added support for an optional correlation_id field defaulting to 'NONE' appended to the end of the formatted string ('actor|action|target|correlation_id').

Verification: Updated test suite to verify default 'NONE' correlation_id formatting, presence in event dict, and explicit function argument overriding. All 3 pytest tests pass and ruff check passes cleanly.
